classifiedFinding.title: Pauser can sandwich pause/unpause cycles to selectively deny yield to specific stakers

classification.assetImpact: Pauser-aligned stakers extract disproportionate yield; targeted stakers forced into pauseWithdraw forfeit accrued rewards.
attackPath: 1. Pauser observes a substantial accStablePerShare credit pending after collectReward.
2. Pauser pauses immediately after the credit.
3. Target user, needing liquidity, calls pauseWithdraw — forfeiting rewards.
4. Pauser unpauses; pauser-aligned stakers claim normally.
classification.likelihood: depends on pauser acting adversarially or colluding
classification.assumptions: Adversarial / colluding pauser; KI-6 acknowledges pauser trust

classifiedFinding.justification: Root cause IS the acknowledged KI-6 pauser trust assumption. The finding sharpens it into a concrete economic exploitation pattern of a documented trusted role. Per C4, exploitation of acknowledged trusted roles routes to the Centralization (C) bundle. Recommendation: minimum unpause-cooldown, multisig pauser.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer flagged for review and predicted demotion to QA/centralization. Classifier confirms: C (centralization) bundle.
